- The setup wizard row now has a Pixel/AOSP choice, defaulting to Pixel. Pixel
  replaces first boot with Google's wizard; AOSP keeps the ROM's own setup wizard
  and adds the Google account step to it, the way NikGApps' SetupWizard option
  does. The experimental warning now applies only to the Pixel flow
- AOSP mode leaves out the bundled language picker, since the ROM's own wizard
  already has one
